_refused_by_the_door: THIS ARTIFACT WAS REFUSED, AND THE REFUSAL IS WHY IT IS HERE. cairn.machines.chart.verdict.write_verdict gates on validate_verdict, which requires every criterion answered AND PASSING — 'a failed criterion is a kick-back, not a crossing'. That is right about the CROSSING and it leaves a hole in the RECORD: the door has exactly one exit, so a kick-back's measurements can be refused loudly to a terminal and berthed nowhere. Five of these eight verdicts failed, so the artifact cannot land beside the stage packets and this file is a ONE-OFF holding place, not a convention — I am coining nothing. The record of truth for this kick-back is the back-edge in cairn/tools/base/history.json (2026-08-12, ticket one-owner-for-the-instance-address); this file is the per-criterion evidence that record summarises. Whether the verdict door grows a kick-back exit is Akien's ruling, not a builder's edit.
